stemMd: What additional evidence would most directly help compare overall durability?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A catalogue restricted to successfully repaired furniture

options.label: B
options.textMd: The colour of the workshop-book covers

options.label: C
options.textMd: A count of repair-book pages alone

options.label: D
options.textMd: A list of the researcher's favourite objects

options.label: E
options.textMd: Records of damage and disposal for objects that bypassed the workshop

explanationMd: The missing cases are damaged objects not repaired in the workshop. Damage and disposal records would help include these cases in the durability comparison.

distractorRationale.b: Cover colour does not address recording bias.
distractorRationale.d: Preference does not supply missing damage data.
distractorRationale.a: This retains the same selection problem.
distractorRationale.c: Page count still omits discarded objects.
